first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and simplifying onboarding has prior durable evidence of improving completion, time-to-value, and early adoption, corroborated by signup simplification results. Promotional pricing is highly relevant to the competitor threat, but its inherited evidence has a pooled-cohort limitation and may carry longer-term value risk; verify it before displacing the more directly evidenced onboarding response.
